glosses: to hold between (e.g. one's fingers, chopsticks)
to catch (e.g. a finger in a door)
to insert (e.g. a break into proceedings)
to be on either side of (a road, table, etc.)
to be across (a street, river, etc.)

exampleTranslations.2: He stuck his pencil behind his ear.
exampleTranslations.5: They confronted each other across the table.
